text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Mobile network operators' adaptive 5G antennas fulfil the implementing guidelines to the Ordinance on Protection against Non-Ionising Radiation (NIRO).", "gist": "Adaptive 5G antennas meet radiation protection guidelines."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "This was the result of an in-depth examination of network operators by OFCOM.", "gist": "OFCOM conducted a thorough review of network operators."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Both the automatic power lock and the quality assurance systems of the antennas meet the legal requirements.", "gist": "Antennas' automatic power lock and quality assurance systems comply with legal standards."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "This means that the cantons can approve the use of adaptive antennas in mobile networks.", "gist": "Cantons are now able to approve adaptive antenna usage."}, {"type": "date", "quote": "summer 2020", "gist": "Tests were conducted in summer 2020."}, {"type": "date", "quote": "March 2020", "gist": "DETEC assigned OFCOM the task in March 2020."}]}
